wl-cookie-banner.name: WL Cookie Banner
wl-cookie-banner.description: Lightweight cookie notice with accept, reject and per-category choice. Works with the WP Consent API and Google Consent Mode v2.

wl-login-guard.name: WL Login Guard
wl-login-guard.description: Moves the login to a custom address, hides wp-login.php and /wp-admin from logged-out visitors, blocks XML-RPC and hides usernames.

wl-updater.name: WL Updater
wl-updater.description: Keeps Wisionary Lab plugins up to date from GitHub, through the normal WordPress update screen.
